items.label: 1B
items.claim: Caris is publicly weighing sequencing suppliers other than its incumbent while it ramps lab capacity and spends heavily on capex.
items.detail: On the Q2'26 call (5 Aug 2026), CFO Luke Power said Caris is looking at additional sequencing capabilities beyond its current supplier. Q2 capex was $22.1M, which absorbed free cash flow, and inventory rose $47M q/q as Caris invested ahead of the Caris Detect ramp. GAAP gross margin was 68% vs 63% a year earlier, with H2 guided to about 60%. The vendor is not named in the excerpt, and this is the call's wording, not a contract change.
items.quote: additional sequencing capabilities, not just what our current existing supplier is
items.why_new: The 'two competitors' quote is known. This adds the $22.1M Q2 capex, the +$47M inventory build and the Power remark on assessing other sequencing technologies, which were not in the exclusion list.
